scope: Original source glTF/BIN bind frames only, readonly. No models combined, translated, resized, deformed or saved.
space: Bone world frames expressed in Java px: J @ world_gltf @ inv(J), J=diag(-16,16,-16,1). Origin differences are Mossy minus Player.
matrix_source: inverse binary float32 inverseBindMatrices; both rigs independently cross-checked against local glTF node hierarchy.

bind_pose_conclusion.statement: The six original armor meshes already assembled in player bind world space can be overlaid in Mossy bind world space without guessed translation, scale or deformation for frame alignment. This does not assert absence of visual intersections, runtime pose equivalence or an existing native monster armor attachment.

material_differences: J_R_Arm origins match but world orientation differs by 180 degrees. J_R_Hand world frames do match. Keep the proven J_R_Hand socket parent; do not substitute J_R_Arm.
Head marker differs slightly because its parent is J_Head for player and J_Neck for Skeleton. Armor uses J_Head, whose full world frame matches.
J_Hip/J_L_Hip and J_Spine/J_L_Spine have different labels; these two explicit structural comparisons are recorded separately from exact-name matches.

paperdoll_native_assignment_recheck.scope: Existing exact-extracted raw assets and their parsed tagged properties only; no new directory/PAK/payload search.
paperdoll_native_assignment_recheck.reason: All three relevant BP generated classes terminate at native /Script/Dungeons.GearActor. Paperdoll template terminates at native /Script/Dungeons.Default__GearActor.Paperdoll, with class /Script/Dungeons.PaperdollComponent. None serializes SkeletalMesh. Native class constructor/default object values are absent from these raw asset files.
paperdoll_native_assignment_recheck.supporting_but_not_assignment_proof: NatureArmor Paperdoll AnimationData.AnimToPlay references Player_Master_Run. SK_Player_Master.Skeleton separately references Player_Master_Skeleton. Six original socket names and bind frames agree; none supplies the missing native Paperdoll SkeletalMesh property assignment.

limitations: Bind-pose frame comparison only; no animation retargeting or runtime original-image pose verified.
Skeleton_Skeleton has no six player armor socket definitions; coordinate agreement does not invent native socket existence.
No whole-skeleton substitution by equal names: J_R_Arm and Head have recorded orientation differences.
Comparison does not modify the frozen armor_for_blockbench.json or any bbmodel.
